settings.text:
Mir Kash is a conscious luxury brand founded by Rajul Daga in 2023. The brand aims to curate magical wardrobe pieces with eye-catching and premium silhouettes, that are manufactured sustainably. High-quality vegan materials are used to curate stunning pieces that are built to last and stand out.

With time, we are continuously introducing products that cater to different purposes. We envision becoming a complete label that offers vegan options in various fashion categories.

Each of our pieces is sculpted with love for a cruelty-free and kinder planet. We want our products to reach modern women who are unconventional, bold, and compassionate.
